cli.title: CLI Access (mvault)
cli.description: The {{cli}} CLI lets you retrieve secrets from a terminal or script. By default, each access triggers a confirmation popup. Enable auto-approval per vault to remove this confirmation. The Auto-get rule also covers {{cli}} ssh and {{cli}} winrm: these connections then use the vault's credentials without confirmation.

aboutPage.framelessWindowDesc: Frameless window with floating card and rounded corners, adapted for small screens
aboutPage.customButtonsDesc: Minimize, maximize and close buttons integrated into the title bar (VS Code style)
aboutPage.improvedSearchDesc: Search now traverses the current folder and its subfolders recursively
aboutPage.tagSearchDesc: Use #tag to filter by tag, combinable with free text and multi-tags (#infra #prod)
aboutPage.tagCreationDesc: Create new tags directly from the tag context menu
aboutPage.restoreDeletedDesc: Right-click a deleted secret to recover it (KV v2)
aboutPage.shiftClickDesc: Select a range of entries with Shift+Click, like on Windows
aboutPage.bugFixesDesc: Short name display in list view, URL validation without protocol, exclusive context menus
aboutPage.v17PasskeysDesc: Passwordless sign-in on supported sites; the private key stays in your encrypted vault
aboutPage.v17RemoteDesc: SSH sessions (key, password or interactive shell) and Windows commands (WinRM) using a vault secret, without ever exposing it
aboutPage.v17AuditDesc: Detects weak, reused and breached passwords (Have I Been Pwned, privacy-preserving)
aboutPage.v17CryptoDesc: scrypt (memory-hard) key derivation for new vaults; existing vaults stay fully compatible
aboutPage.v17UiDesc: More readable sidebar header and consistent checkboxes in dark mode
aboutPage.v17FixesDesc: Local-mode size limit raised to 10 MB, corrected HTTP error codes, apostrophes accepted in usernames, Windows/UNC paths accepted as URLs, persistent SSH host key verification.

ldap.title: LDAP authentication
ldap.autoSyncText: A cron script runs every 3 minutes on the Vault server to automatically synchronize groups from {{ou}}. New AD groups are automatically added to Vault with the default policy, and groups deleted from AD are removed from Vault.
ldap.configuredText: The groups listed above are automatically synchronized from your Active Directory. Each group is created in Vault with {{policy}} on the first synchronization.
ldap.addText: To add a new AD group to Vault:
ldap.addStep1: Create the group in the {{ou}} OU of your Active Directory
ldap.addStep2: Wait up to 3 minutes (automatic synchronization via cron)
ldap.addStep3: The new group will automatically appear in Vault with {{policy}}
ldap.addStep4: Then assign the desired policies to the group in the "Policies" tab
ldap.scriptText: The {{script}} script automatically handles adding and removing groups. Logs are available in {{log}}.
ldap.unavailableText: You do not have permission to read the LDAP configuration, or it is not configured.
